GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 680.2 (22 May 48) GA
(SCAPIN - 1971/2)
APO 500
14 March 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Charges for Services Rendered to Personnel Entering Japan to Visit Relatives.
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 095 (22 May 48) GA, SCAPIN 1971, subject, "Entry of Personnel into Japan to Visit Relatives," dated 11 February 1949.
2. The Japanese Government is authorized to charge each visitor entering Japan under the provisions of reference paragraph 1 above a maximum of one thousand yen (¥1,000) for services rendered by the Japan Travel Bureau as required by said reference memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
